HA_worms_rtp.description: cross-scale persistence of horizontal-gradient maxima of the reduced-to-pole magnetic field, upward-continued 0-8 km

HA_worms_grav.description: same worming operator on the isostatic gravity anomaly

HB_tdr_rtp.description: tilt-derivative zero-contour steepness on RTP magnetics

HB_tdr_grav.description: tilt-derivative zero-contour steepness on isostatic gravity

HC_hinge.description: linear steps in depth-to-conductive-base restricted to topographically flat ground (buried structures only)

HD_strain_raw.description: geodetic 2nd invariant minus earthquake density (fault-density term is added per holdout fold from the VISIBLE catalogue only)

HE_lin_tc.description: oriented matched-filter lineaments in band `tc` (GeoDAWN radiometric total count - see irregularity I-2)

HE_lin_cond.description: oriented matched-filter lineaments in surface conductivity

BASE_topo_ridge.description: BASELINE: topographic scarp/ridge detector on detrended-elevation slope - the family this team has already submitted repeatedly

BASE_tmi_hg.description: BASELINE: single-scale horizontal-gradient ridge on the provided TMI horizontal gradient band
